name: Doomloader
about: Doomloader is a video and audio downloader for Android, built by Doomsage on top of the open source Seal project.

steps.title: Download the APK
steps.text: Tap Install on this page once it is available.

steps.title: Allow installs
steps.text: Android asks to allow your browser to install apps. Allow it once.

steps.title: Open and install
steps.text: Open the downloaded file and tap Install.
